slides.heading: Get it checked if you notice
items: One tender spot on the bone
Pain at night or at rest

caption:
Pain in one spot on your shin that gets worse the longer you run? It could be your bone asking for a break.

Bone gets stronger with running, but it adapts more slowly than muscle. Sudden jumps in kms or speed work, too little recovery and not eating enough for your training can all contribute. Often it's several things at once.

Pain that builds during a run, one tender spot on the bone, pain when hopping, or pain at night is worth assessing. Bone stress usually needs a genuine reduction in running, while cycling or swimming can often continue.

Our Sydney CBD physios can plan a gradual return to running. Book online via the link in bio.
